text:
nora (product): short sync: customers asking for a clear onboarding checklist for enterprise compliance features (audit exports, BYOK/KMS, retention lanes). want contractable acceptance tests.
chao (eng): propose tiny MVP: cloud-KMS handshake, 90d hot audit index with on-demand NDJSON export, tenant-level retention flag + TTL job. no cold archive in MVP.
keisha (security): must capture key-id, attestation-token (when available), and rotation events in audit logs. also define acceptable attestation options (partner vs in-house).
pablo (sales): two pilots: TrustEdge requires HSM attestation; ScaleCo ok with cloud KMS. TrustEdge wants timeline and written acceptance tests.
maria (custeng): ScaleCo asks: searchable recent logs (<15m), on-demand export, and ability to set tenant retention to 7y. they accept phased delivery.
nora (product): draft acceptance tests here: 1) BYOK handshake: POST /v1/keystore/handshake -> returns key-ref; audit log contains key-ref and status. 2) Export: GET /v1/audit/export?tenant&start&end -> NDJSON schema v1 with chain-of-custody headers. 3) Retention toggle: set retention=7y -> TTL job marks tombstone; export includes deletion markers.
chao (eng): note: recent-search <15m needs hot index; 7y will be cold and paginated. will add cost estimate and SLO options.
keisha (security): for TrustEdge, offer partner-attestation path; security will draft a minimal threat-model and attestation acceptance criteria. regression tests must assert request-id, tenant-id, route, model-version, kms-key-id in every audit entry.
contracts-bot: ticket COMP-9999 created "Compliance onboarding: acceptance tests + partner attestation" assigned to product/eng/security.
nora (product): next steps: chao + keisha to draft tech-spec + test harness by EOW; contracts to draft acceptance language; pablo to prioritize pilots. keep Phase A lean.
